author: gta6plus
text:
If 32 is GTA 6 Online’s final player limit, that wouldn't be much of an increase over GTA Online’s current 30.

So why does Rockstar call its “online 32 player format” one of the company’s “most closely guarded secrets”?

The new tribunal filing doesn’t reveal whether 32 is the limit, a testing format or part of something much bigger.

Made by the team at @GTABOOM_.

author: thegameverse
text:
Rockstar was testing GTA VI Online with 32 players, and keeping it secret 👀

Court filings from the ongoing UK tribunal show staff discussing an “online 32 player format” during internal testing. Rockstar’s lawyers described the number as one of the company’s “most closely guarded secrets.”

That matches today’s GTA Online lobby size, but it doesn’t confirm the final player cap.

Would you want GTA 6 Online to have more or fewer than 32 players?

author: tactininja
text:
New GTA 6 screenshots from the Leonida Keys.

This is the part of Grand Theft Auto 6 that isn’t Vice City clubs. Bridges, seaplanes, iguanas in the road, diving with turtles, boats everywhere, some guy passed out at The Rusty Anchor.

Rockstar Games built a whole Florida Keys map inside GTA 6. Not a loading screen. 
Not a mission island. 
Just another place you can live in.

GTA 5 had water. 
GTA 6 has a coastline that actually looks lived in.

November 19. You starting in Vice City or heading straight to the Leonida Keys?
